items.title: Fiona the hippo dies after swallowing a hat at Cincinnati Zoo
items.dek: Fiona, who became an internet star after her premature birth in 2017, "fought until she couldn’t anymore", the zoo says.

items.title: Trump posthumously pardons US baseball legend Pete Rose
items.dek: Rose, who died in 2024, was given a lifetime ban from the sport for betting on games but was reinstated last year.
